headword: {通信教育|つうしんきょういく}

definitions.explanation: Education provided remotely through mail, internet, or other media, without requiring physical attendance at a school.

examples.japanese: {通信教育|つうしんきょういく}で{資格|しかく}を{取|と}る。
examples.english: To get a qualification through distance learning.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}をしながら{通信教育|つうしんきょういく}で{大学|だいがく}を{卒業|そつぎょう}した。
examples.english: I graduated from university through correspondence courses while working.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもに{通信教育|つうしんきょういく}の{教材|きょうざい}を{買|か}ってあげた。
examples.english: I bought correspondence course materials for my child.

notes:
{通信教育|つうしんきょういく} is a compound of {通信|つうしん} (communication) and {教育|きょういく} (education).

TYPES:
- {大学|だいがく}{通信|つうしん}{教育|きょういく}: university correspondence courses
- {資格|しかく}{取得|しゅとく}のための{通信|つうしん}{教育|きょういく}: correspondence courses for qualifications
- {子|こ}ども{向|む}け{通信|つうしん}{教育|きょういく}: correspondence courses for children

MODERN CONTEXT:
Increasingly includes online learning (オンライン{学習|がくしゅう}, eラーニング) in addition to traditional mail-based courses.
